overrides.reason: KaTeX generates cjk_fallback spans with its serif math font inheritance, and its public rendering options do not expose a font family for these Unicode text nodes.
overrides.verification: Real Desktop Markdown visual editor rendering inline colored CJK LaTeX beside an H1 heading; inspect the computed font family and screenshot.

overrides.reason: KaTeX applies a fixed 1.21em font shorthand to every rendered formula, and Milkdown exposes no theme option for matching formula size to the surrounding ProseMirror body text.
overrides.verification: Real Desktop Markdown visual editor rendering inline and fenced LaTeX; compare computed formula and paragraph font sizes and inspect light and dark screenshots.

overrides.reason: Crepe renders inline math as an inline-block aligned to the bottom, with no public theme option for preserving the surrounding paragraph baseline and inherited line height.
overrides.verification: Real Desktop Markdown visual editor rendering a fraction inline beside plain text; compare its paragraph height with a plain reference line and inspect for clipping or overlap.

overrides.reason: TextLayerBuilder generates selection sentinel and br nodes; its public API has no styles for Chromium drag boundary handling. These match the installed PDF.js viewer rules.
overrides.verification: Real Desktop drag selection on annotated phenology PDF, forward/reverse across lines and formulas, at multiple scales.
